hypothesis_text: Higher age is associated with increased dementia incidence.
Greater years of education are linked to lower dementia incidence (cognitive reserve).
Women have higher lifetime risk of Alzheimer’s disease than men, partly due to longevity.
APOE ε4 carriage increases risk for Alzheimer’s disease across ethnicities.
Hispanic ethnicity shows attenuated APOE ε4 effect compared with Whites.
Married status is associated with lower risk of dementia vs. unmarried/widowed.
